news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Vega loane will miss some time with knee injury
news.desc: Vega loane will miss some time due to an MCL sprain.
news.impact: This is a tough injury for the Ravens, as loane has been having a great rookie season. The 14th-overall pick in this year's draft is reportedly dealing with a "short-term" issue, but it will likely force him to miss at least a game or two. Emery Jones Jr. stepped in for loane in Sunday's game.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Eagles D/ST dismal in loss Monday
news.desc: The Eagles' D/ST failed to log a turnover or sack while allowing 38 points in Monday night's loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Philadelphia's defense fell flat on their face on Monday. They allowed Dallas to score 38 points over the course of the night, and they weren't able to log any big plays to help out their own offense. This unit is usually much better than this and should bounce back sometime in the near future.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Jake Elliott perfect in loss Monday
news.desc: Jake Elliott went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Monday night's loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Elliott did his job on Monday night, knocking down all three of his attempted kicks in a loss to the Cowboys. He was left with a small fantasy total since they were all extra points, but he should bounce back sometime in the near future.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Hollywood Brown racks up 30 yards Monday
news.desc: Hollywood Brown caught 2-of-5 targets for 30 yards in Monday's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: The veteran wideout had to step up with Philadelphia missing multiple key wideouts due to injury on Monday night. He was able to rack up 30 yards on the night, but he was limited to just two catches and didn't get into the end zone at all. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Dameon Pierce finds end zone Monday
news.desc: Dameon Pierce rushed the ball 14 times for 47 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Pierce saw the most carries on the team on Monday night, with Saquon Barkley (hamstring) still having a limited workload in his return game. Barkley seems to have gotten banged up in this game as well, so if he's out next week, Pierce will prove to be startable in a lot of league formats in a matchup against the Commanders on Sunday night next week.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Darius Cooper quiet in loss Monday
news.desc: Darius Cooper caught 1-of-3 targets for just 17 yards in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: The Eagles weren't able to get Cooper going on Monday, as he finished with just 17 yards in this loss to their divisional rival. He will likely have a couple of boom games over the remainder of the season, but fantasy managers shouldn't trust him at this point.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Makai Lemon plays well in loss Monday
news.desc: Makai Lemon caught 7-of-8 targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: The rookie finally had a high-production game, finishing with the most receptions, receiving yards, and touchdowns out of anyone on the team on Monday night. This performance was a good sign that he's not dead in the water after a slow start to the season, but he's unlikely to keep up at this pace when DeVonta Smith (hamstring) makes his return to the lineup.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Saquon Barkley gets banged up in return game Monday
news.desc: Saquon Barkley rushed the ball seven times for 62 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Monday night was Barkley's return game after he misses several weeks with a hamstring issue. He looked good with 62 yards and a touchdown in his limited action, but he tweaked his hamstring and suffered a new back issue that may affect him moving forward. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his injury status heading into Week 8.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Dallas Goedert hauls in five passes Monday
news.desc: Dallas Goedert hauled in 5-of-7 targets for 48 yards in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: The veteran played pretty well on Monday. He hauled in five passes over the course of the game and was able to turn that into 48 yards, but he didn't get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy finish in most league formats. He will likely continue to be startable moving forward, especially if DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses more time.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Tanner McKee throws one touchdown in loss Monday
news.desc: Tanner McKee completed 23-of-35 passing attempts for 211 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: McKee got the start for Philadelphia on Monday night. He didn't have a very strong showing against the Cowboys, but it wasn't all bad, finishing with 200 yards and a touchdown with one pick. He is not expected to be fantasy relevant moving forward, however.
